KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_4: Strange. Are they all broken? This isn't safe at all. I'll have to call maintenance tomorrow and get them fixed.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_40: Cartethyia's clear voice sweeps away all the tension. The corners of your mouth twitch several times, but in the end, you can't hold it in and let out a laugh.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_41: Huh?! Why are you laughing?! D-Did I mess something up?!
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_42: Waah... I'm from a really tiny village, and I only got into this school because of my athletic talent. I'm not good at anything except being strong, but... I still want to help everyone...
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_43: Does that message contain something really important? Is this all because I keep falling asleep in class...?
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_44: Cartethyia works herself into a panic all on her own. Oddly enough, that's what draws a small laugh from the club member who was falling apart moments ago.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_46: I think everyone in the club feels the same way I do. Cartethyia, you've really inspired all of us.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_47: Maybe it's because everyone has finally relaxed, but you don't run into anything else strange on the rest of the way home.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_48: Well then, this is where we leave you—
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_49: Suddenly, something drops right in front of you. It glints silver under the streetlight... and it's flopping around.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_5: Still deep in thought, Cartethyia leads the way.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_50: Is this... a live fish? It looks like some animal has taken a few bites out of it, leaving some of its scales missing.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_51: Just as you're wondering where it came from and reach out to deal with it—
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_55: F-Fish are heretical beings from the deep sea, wielding the wicked power to control minds...
KTXY_AVGcharacter_3_7: As if sensing your footsteps, the dark streetlights suddenly begin flickering at random.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_11: (The streetlights and the sign are in the same area. It looks like they're controlled by the same mechanism.)
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_13: (The fish has bite marks, and it fell right where the cat was headed. The cat must have dropped it while carrying it off.)
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_14: (Consider how the two might be connected.)
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_15: (The streetlights flicker and the sign lights up at random, but there's no one in any of the nearby buildings.)
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_16: Someone could use the fish as bait to lure the cat into the control room. That would make the streetlights and sign flicker at random.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_17: Cartethyia, your roundhouse kick scared the cat out of the control room. Then, a while later, it accidentally let go of the fish in its mouth, which fell right in front of us.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_18: After all, you can't exactly control what a cat does.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_19: Wow... That explains everything we ran into! That's incredible, {PlayerName}!
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_2: Cartethyia is trembling inside the cramped warehouse.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_20: So our next goal is to find that control room! I feel like we're getting closer and closer to finding the culprit!
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_21: And so, after some time spent investigating, you find this warehouse.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_22: The Celestial Steed Corp logo is emblazoned on its door. Hoping to find more clues, you push the door open and discover the culprits' plan.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_23: {PlayerName}, look! It seems like they're trying to stop us from participating in the National Music Competition!
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_24: With this, we've got them dead to rights! Hehe, knightly quest: a smashing success!
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_25: Neither of you notices the footsteps coming from outside the door.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_26: Let's go home for today. Tomorrow, we can take this to a teacher at school—
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_3: She sits huddled in a corner against the wall, wrapping her arms tightly around her knees. Her lips are pale, and she can't even respond to you.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_30: Back to the present. Ever since you were locked in the warehouse, Cartethyia hasn't been herself.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_31: The usual light in her eyes is completely gone, replaced by a fear that looks as though she's trapped in a nightmare.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_32: Now, she remains curled up in the corner, trembling slightly.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_34: Is there anything I can do?
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_35: (Say nothing and quietly stay by her side.)
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_37: Could you... sit a little closer to me...?
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_38: You nod and sit down right beside Cartethyia against the wall.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_39: Perhaps sensing you beside her, she finally loosens her grip around her knees and slowly reaches for your hand. Her palm feels ice-cold.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_4: The golden-haired girl who's always so bright and lively, lifting everyone up with her cheer and energy... You've never seen her look like this before.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_40: I'm sorry... I-I can't quite control myself...
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_41: You know she means the fear that has suddenly gripped her. Of course, you don't blame Cartethyia. You smile and shake your head, then take her cold hand in yours.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_42: It's okay. Whatever happened, you can tell me.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_43: Perhaps sensing your sincerity, Cartethyia lets out a breath of relief and slowly relaxes.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_45: Actually... I'm very afraid of being locked in a room.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_46: For some reason, you feel like you've heard a similar story before.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_47: A golden-haired Blessed Maiden, imprisoned in solitude. But where have you heard this story before?
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_48: I never met my birth parents. I grew up in an orphanage... But all the adults there were busy, so I was always locked in my room.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_49: There was nothing in the room. No toys, no decorations, no light. Just one tiny little window, through which I could hear the noisy world outside.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_50: Why was I the only one who had to suffer? Why wasn't I one of the children laughing outside...? The longer I stayed there, the more those thoughts filled my mind.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_51: Luckily, I still had that story.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_52: You know which story she means.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_53: "A righteous knight battling the evil Threnodian!" I imagined myself as the knight in the story and fought those dark thoughts in my heart as if I were dueling an enemy.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_54: Only by doing that could I... keep living with the same hope as everyone else.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_55: You understand now. Cartethyia has sunk into this gloom because the cramped, closed-off warehouse has trapped her back in a past she'd rather not remember.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_59: This warehouse stores printed materials, so there are plenty of loose sheets of paper and paints lying around. You grab a handful and spread them out before Cartethyia.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_6: It all goes back to that investigation.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_60: After defeating the Threnodian, the knight begins a new adventure.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_61: She befriends a great dragon, who invites her to ride upon its back and soar through the skies. The dragon says its name is—
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_63: As the two of you talk, Cartethyia picks up a pen and begins drawing the pale dragon.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_64: The knight and Gehinnom continue their journey and meet a powerful swordsman named Cadanto. The knight trains under him, and after years of grueling practice, she becomes the number one swordswoman in the kingdom!
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_66: Cartethyia's hand pauses for a moment as she draws. Then she looks up at you with a smile.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_67: The knight comes to a small town, where she meets an adventurer dressed in black.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_68: Then the knight and the adventurer become friends.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_69: And their journey will go on forever.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_7: Cartethyia's panic over the fish that fell from the sky soon subsides. After seeing the Orchestral Music Club member home, you begin analyzing everything you've encountered along the way.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_71: They'll travel across every mountain and river in the world, journey through every season, through day and night, listening to the whispers of the wind and the roar of the tides, watching flowers bloom and snow fall...
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_72: Until their deeds are praised in song in every corner of the world.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_74: No longer trembling, the girl closes her eyes and lets out a soft breath. Then she gets to her feet and walks toward the door imprisoning you both.
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_8: Flickering streetlights... the illuminated sign... the cat in the room... and that fish that suddenly fell from the sky...
KTXY_AVGcharacter_4_9: Do you think all these things we encountered might be connected, {PlayerName}?
SolarSchoolAffairs_3_Content:
As <color=#d19f27>Miss Galbrena</color> hands you the exam papers that need copying, a <color=#d19f27>strange sheet of paper</color> slips out.
It is... the wanted notice for the ringleader of a shooting that shocked the world two years ago? The name has been crossed out, and <color=#d19f27>the mark looks like the handwriting Miss Galbrena uses to grade tests</color>...
She says nothing. She simply folds the sheet and tucks it into her pocket.
SolarSchoolAffairs_4_Content:
During <color=#d19f27>Miss Verina</color>'s class, Cartethyia quietly slips you a note inviting you to go exploring on the streets after school.
What you do not notice is that, while you read it, Miss Verina has come to stand right behind you.
<color=#d19f27>"{PlayerName}, what are you reading?"</color>
SolarSchoolAffairs_5_Content:
To prepare for the Nationals, you extend today's rehearsal by two hours.
But you are not the only ones who know how hard everyone has worked. During a short break, <color=#d19f27>Roccia</color> quietly calls you over to the school store.
"Seeing everyone try so hard really touched me. I baked some cookies for them. Could you help me hand them out, {PlayerName}?"
Roccia's kindness warms you through. But after a whole afternoon of rehearsal, everyone is parched, and would probably like a <color=#d19f27>cold drink</color> better than cookies...
SolarSchoolAffairs_6_Content: <color=#d19f27>Chisa</color> wants to bring more customers into the family restaurant. Which <color=#d19f27>marketing strategy</color> would work best?
SolarSchoolAffairs_7_Content: A customer wants to pick out a Teachers' Day gift for <color=#d19f27>Miss Verina</color>. What should you recommend?
SolarSchoolAffairs_8_Content: A customer asks for something <color=#d19f27>with a real kick</color>. What should you recommend?
SolarSchoolAffairs_9_Content: A classmate asks you to help find some references for his <color=#d19f27>physical training plan</color>. Since he is a beginner, who do you think he should learn from?
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_3_1: Take the papers and pretend you did not see a thing.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_3_2: Gasp in shock and beg Miss Galbrena to spare you.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_3_3: Casually bring up your brutal battle with a giant sandworm.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_4_1: Come clean and apologize together with Cartethyia.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_4_2: Eat the note and say Miss Verina must be seeing things.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_4_3: Claim it's your own notes and find a way out of trouble.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_5_1: Say nothing to Roccia, and buy two more cases of drinks to hand out together.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_5_2: Suggest Roccia wrap up the cookies for everyone to take home.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_5_3: Explain honestly and stay with Roccia to get some drinks ready.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_8_1: The jumbo ice cream Miss Galbrena always orders.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_8_2: The Laurus Salad Cartethyia always orders.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_8_3: The Jinzhou Maocai Changli always orders.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_9_2: Run laps around the athletic field with Cartethyia.
SolarSchoolAffairs_Opt_9_3: Typing is exercise too. Take the forum by storm with Buling!
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_artCreati: Immerse yourself in the creative process and turn inspiration into a unique work of art.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_campusGre: Sweep public areas and keep the school grounds clean.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_campusPro: Make promotional materials and tell students and teachers about the school's recent events and news.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_coastalSk: Walk along the coast, taking in the scenery and noting down sights and ideas for daily life.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_dailyExer: Use your free time after class to get moving and keep up a regular exercise habit.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_documentP: Organize files, and draft and check Student Council documents.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_goShoppin: Stroll between the streets and stores at leisure and enjoy a rare bit of free time.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_humanitie: Go over the key points and broaden your thinking through reading in class.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_managemen: Coordinate duties and on-site arrangements to keep club activities running smoothly.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_organizeG: Take stock of the school store's inventory and tidy the shelves so goods are neatly arranged.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_partTimeW: Greet customers, take down their orders, and pass them on to the kitchen.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_physicalT: Stick with physical conditioning to build endurance and fitness.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_reception: Check customers' bills and handle payment at the register.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_rehearsal: Join club members in training and help adjust the practice content and pace.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_restAtHom: Set your busy schedule aside for a while and relax body and mind somewhere comfortable.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_restockSu: Take stock of the supplies needed for events, then buy whatever is missing.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_salesAssi: Explain product features to customers and offer suitable purchase recommendations.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_scienceCl: Work through formulas and problem-solving techniques to consolidate what you have learned.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_secureSpo: Talk with partners and negotiate sponsorship terms and event plans.
SolarSchoolBehaviorDescription_substitut: Help the teachers organize teaching materials and answer classmates' questions.
SolarSchoolBehaviorName_receptionService: Ringing up customers at the front desk...
SolarSchoolEndingDesc2: Companion Ending: The Warmth of Fireworks
SolarSchoolEndingDesc3: Companion Ending: A Journey of Freedom
SolarSchoolEventCheck_14_Desc: You and Namipon encounter the first foe on your journey: <color=#d19f27>"Maid Namipon"</color>, a vision of grace and beauty whose singing can banish all the world's troubles. It's about to unleash its ultimate move, "Namipon's Leitmotif." You decide to...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_15_Desc: "After all those trials, you and Regular Namipon must be inseparable by now." To your surprise, Chisa and her Namipon step forward to challenge you. With an air utterly unlike her usual self, she sweeps back her long hair, strikes a cool pose, and declares, "I am <color=#d19f27>Gym Leader Kuchiba Chisa</color>. Trainer {PlayerName}, show me what you've got!"
SolarSchoolEventCheck_16_Desc:
You and <color=#d19f27>Chisa</color> arrive at the shop you'd arranged to visit, only to find <color=#d19f27>the door firmly shut</color>. No one answers your knocks, and the owner won't pick up the phone. 
You'll have to find another way to get the supplies you need for the event...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_17_Desc:
You and <color=#d19f27>Chisa</color> present your proposal to a major shopping mall chain. After reviewing it, the representative offers to sponsor only <color=#d19f27>half the supplies</color> you've requested. 
With these supplies crucial to your upcoming events, it's time to negotiate...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_18_Desc:
Officer <color=#d19f27>Xiangli Yao</color> hands you a club application from a student group called the"Multi-Turret Club," dedicated to researching and building combat robots. Looking a little conflicted, he leaves it to you to decide <color=#d19f27>whether to approve</color> the application. 
The Student Council is here to serve the students. The call is yours.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_19_Desc:
Your on-campus safety talk has hit a snag: far more students have shown up than the venue can accommodate. At this rate, the safety talk itself is becoming a safety hazard! <color=#d19f27>Changli</color>, the main speaker, gives you a pointed look. Unless someone steps in, the event will have to be canceled.
Think fast. You're the only one who can <color=#d19f27>save the event</color>!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_20_Desc:
Club Leader <color=#d19f27>Ciaccona</color> has a problem: two percussionists have called in sick with colds. With a crucial part of the ensemble missing, the Orchestra Club can't hold its <color=#d19f27>ensemble rehearsal</color> as planned. 
Fortunately, you've already got an idea...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_21_Desc:
The Vocal Music Club and Dance Club are at odds over <color=#d19f27>the same rehearsal space</color>. You and Cartethyia rush to the scene. Both clubs need the venue to rehearse their new performances, and neither will budge.
When talking gets you nowhere, <color=#d19f27>Cartethyia</color> silently rolls up her sleeves. You stop her and assure her you've got a plan...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_22_Desc:
On a clear day, you head to the coast with your painting supplies. Beneath the cloudless sky, blue waves roll in the breeze, sunlight glinting off the water like scattered silver. Beachgoers bustle nearby as waterbirds skim low over the shore. All is calm and peaceful.
The scene sparks your inspiration. You unfurl your canvas and <color=#d19f27>raise your brush</color>...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_3_Desc:
You get caught daydreaming in <color=#d19f27>Miss Verina's</color> math class and are promptly "volunteered" to solve a problem at the board: 3×4=?
Looks easy enough, but who knows? There could be a trick. Stay sharp! Just then, a helpful classmate in the audience holds up a sign with the answer: <color=#d19f27>12</color>!
So, the answer is—
SolarSchoolEventCheck_4_Desc: You're lost in the symphony's beautiful melodies when someone tugs at your sleeve... You follow the tug and look down. Wait, why is there a capybara floating in midair?! And it's wearing a white bow tie! It blinks at you and asks, <color=#d19f27>"Dear guest, can you sing 'Namipon's Leitmotif'?"</color>
SolarSchoolEventCheck_5_Desc:
A <color=#d19f27>crumpled note</color> sails in a perfect arc from the back row and lands on your desk. Inside is a single question: <color=#d19f27>"What's the answer to the multiple-choice questions?"</color>
You glance back. The sender is watching you with barely concealed hope. Rather than endure that expectant stare for the rest of the exam, you decide to...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_6_Desc: A few <color=#d19f27>rough-looking customers</color> have barged into the store. Four of them, and none look friendly. The burly man in front pulls three apples from his shopping basket, slams them onto the counter, and growls, "You! <color=#d19f27>Split these three apples evenly among us four brothers</color>! Can't do it? Then I ain't paying a cent!"
SolarSchoolEventCheck_7_Desc: You stop and try opening one of the classroom doors. Then...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_8_Desc: Something clatters to the floor. You tighten your grip on your flashlight and slowly approach the corner...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_9_Desc: A "ghost" in an old school uniform peeks out from a cabinet, waiting to see how you will react...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_1: Regular Namipon, I choose you! Use <color=#d19f27>"Tackle"</color>!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_1_Fail: Hang on. Does Namipon even understand that command? And shouldn't you strike a cooler pose when you shout it? While you're busy wondering, Maid Namipon launches into "Namipon's Leitmotif," and Regular Namipon, tired of waiting for orders, takes its paw and starts singing along: Bo bo bo, bo ba bo bo...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_1_Suc: "Namipon, Namipon!" Regular Namipon gets the message. Puffing out its cheeks to the absolute limit, it charges at Maid Namipon like a fluffy cannonball. Just before impact, Maid Namipon obligingly keels over. It's role-play, after all, and both Namipons seem to be loving it!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_2: Who says Trainers can't join the fight? <color=#d19f27>Get hands-on</color> and clamp Maid Namipon's snout shut!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_2_Fail: You charge in confidently, ready to pinch Maid Namipon's snout shut. But the moment you touch it, that fluffy fur wins you over! Before you know it, you're stroking its silky coat as "Namipon's Leitmotif" plays in the background...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_2_Suc: Before Maid Namipon can sing a note, you dash in and clamp its snout shut! Silenced, it has no choice but to remove its apron and wave it like a white flag. Regular Namipon is so impressed by your audacity that it declares you its Trainer.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_3_Fail: "Maid Namipon, I've always believed in your potential, but frankly, your current performance has been a real disappointment." You try borrowing the sort of carefully crafted rhetoric people use to curry favor, and it does get Maid Namipon to stop singing. But now, both Namipons are staring at you like you're the most insufferable person they've ever met...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_14_3_Suc: "Maid Namipon, why spend your whole life cooped up here? Come travel the world with me!" You put on your best cartoon-hero voice, and it works like a charm! Maid Namipon calls off the battle, and the three of you join hands to sing "Namipon's Leitmotif" in celebration of your newfound friendship.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_1_Fail: You put so much thought into strategy that you call your move a beat too late. Chisa's Namipon strikes first, ramming your Regular Namipon square in the belly and sending it tumbling to the ground, dazed. Looks like that's the match!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_1_Suc: "Namipon, Namipon!" "Namipon, Namipon!" Sensing their Trainers' determination, the two Namipons collide in the middle of the gym like bouncy rice dumplings, trading blows without either giving an inch. You and Chisa exchange knowing smiles. Looks like the Namipons are having a blast!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_2: Duel <color=#d19f27>in style</color>—Regular Namipon, use "None shall whisper"!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_2_Fail: Shouting a move name this grand takes serious lung capacity, but sadly, you've been skipping your workouts. Your battle cry comes out short of breath and fails to intimidate Chisa's Namipon. Regular Namipon gives it everything, but against Chisa's all-out assault, it's just not enough...
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_2_Suc: "Namipon!" A sharp glint flashes in Regular Namipon's eyes. Fired up by your battle cry, it takes to the air at astonishing speed, as though black wings have sprouted from its back! Chisa's Namipon is overwhelmed by the display, and Regular Namipon bonks it clean out cold. And that's the match!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_3: Duel <color=#d19f27>casually</color>—Regular Namipon, use "Attack Like You Just Spotted Half-Price Chips"!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_3_Fail: Nobody can resist half-price chips, not even Namipon... or Chisa's Namipon! Your delivery sounds so much like a supermarket clearance announcement that both Namipons believe the deal is real. The glorious battle devolves into a chaotic brawl on an imaginary sales floor. What a disaster!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_15_3_Suc: "Namipon! Namipon!" Nobody can resist half-price chips, and Regular Namipon is no exception. With a wicked grin, it dodges and weaves through the imaginary stampede to the snack aisle, slipping behind Chisa's Namipon in a flash to land the finishing blow! Half-price chips are the victor's crown!
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_1: Visit the shop next door and <color=#d19f27>see what you can find out</color>.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_1_Fail:
You talk with the manager of the shop next door, but learn nothing useful.
Looks like you'll have to return another time to collect the supplies.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_1_Suc: You learn from the shop next door that the owner has a habit of locking up for an afternoon nap. You and your companion keep knocking until you finally wake the owner and secure the event supplies.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_2: Call the owner out with <color=#d19f27>a song</color>.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_2_Fail:
Under Chisa's startled gaze, you start to sing. But your singing is rather hard on the ears, so much so that a passerby steps in to stop you.
Looks like you'll have to come back another time to pick up the supplies.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_2_Suc: Chisa stares in surprise as you break into song. Your voice rings out, loud and lovely, and before long the shop door swings open. The owner, woken from a nap, hands the supplies over to you and Chisa.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_3: Unleash <color=#d19f27>the invincible scissors</color> on the door, together with Chisa.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_3_Fail:
"Isn't this illegal?" Even so, at your request, Chisa takes out the stationery scissors she carries with her. You make a few passes at the door with them, but they plainly don't stand a chance.
Looks like you'll have to come back another time to pick up the supplies.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_16_3_Suc: "Isn't this illegal?" Even so, at your request, Chisa takes out the scissors she carries with her. Just as the two of you are about to go at the door, the owner opens it, a little startled, and hands over the supplies.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_1: Make <color=#d19f27>a concession</color> and promote the mall more at the event.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_1_Fail:
You offer the mall extra publicity at the event, but when it comes to specifics, you draw a blank.
They shake their head and turn down your request.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_1_Suc:
You offer the mall extra publicity at the event and walk the person in charge through the details one by one.
Moved by your sincerity, they agree to the partnership.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_2_Fail:
You stand firm, but the person in charge sees through your bluff.
They shake their head and turn down your request.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_2_Suc:
You don't budge: the full amount, or you take your business elsewhere.
After much deliberation, they agree to the deal.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_3: Time to <color=#d19f27>show off</color> the Liaison Center's track record.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_3_Fail:
You start in on the Liaison Center's past partnerships, but clearly they have no patience for a long-winded speech.
They shake their head and turn down your request.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_17_3_Suc:
You and Chisa lay out photos and records from past partner events.
They study the smiling students in the pictures, go quiet for a moment, then agree to provide all the supplies you need as sponsorship.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_18_1: <color=#d19f27>Vet the club's qualifications strictly</color> against the standards.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_18_1_Fail: The standards... Where was the file with the standards in it, again? Xiangli Yao can't help but put a hand to his forehead and sigh as he watches you turn the Council office upside down.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_18_1_Suc:
You hold the Multi-Turret Club to every standard in the book, and in the end you approve it.
It may not look all that reliable, but it does meet the requirements for founding a hobby club.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_18_2: I need to see these "<color=#d19f27>combat</color> robots" myself.
SolarSchoolEventCheck_Opt_18_2_Fail: You drop by to see the Multi-Turret Club's work so far: a robot dog fitted with several water guns. This looks like an April Fools' joke, so you decide to put the application on hold.

SolarSchoolItemDescription_01:
A graduation gift from Phoebe. A commemorative keepsake from Celestial Steed Corp, crafted from costly materials and worth a great deal. Phoebe gives it to you in the hope that the bluebird will make its way through wind and waves to bring happiness your way.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Phoebe will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_02:
A graduation gift from Xiangli Yao. Beep-Boop was the first creation he completed as a child. Now modified, it says "Happy graduation" when you gently pat its head.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Xiangli Yao will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_03:
A graduation gift from Ciaccona. The pages contain every piece of music she composed while at school. Bring them to her for a little bonus: she will hum the pieces recorded in them for you.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Ciaccona will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_04:
A graduation gift from Buling. Wear these to block out as much outside sound as possible and concentrate on what you are doing.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Buling will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_05:
A graduation gift from Galbrena. Every feather in this handwoven dreamcatcher comes from a bird of prey. With it watching over you through the night, trust that even the fiercest nightmare will not dare come near.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Galbrena will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_06:
A graduation gift from Roccia. The figurine on the music box is from a film she once appeared in. Music plays as the gears turn, wishing you a night filled with starlight.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Roccia will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_07:
A graduation gift from Cartethyia. She sewed these hand puppets herself at the orphanage, and they kept her company through countless lonely nights. Now she gives them to you, hoping the Blessed Maiden's blessing will light your way.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Cartethyia will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_08:
A graduation gift from Changli. The envelope is adorned with red feathers and carries a refreshing fragrance. It must be her way of reminding you to think of her often as you continue your journey.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Changli will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_09:
A graduation gift from Verina. She nurtured the plant in this specimen herself and chose its loveliest leaves for you, hoping good fortune will follow you on your travels.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Verina will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_10:
A graduation gift from Chisa. She made this kirigami artwork herself, capturing everything she holds dear about her hometown. A keepsake for you to take along as you set off on your travels.
When you own this item, the Intimacy level with Chisa will be automatically raised to Close in the next playthrough.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_11:
A planner for keeping track of your schedule and to-do list, specially gifted to you by Abby. Use it to plan your week at a glance.
Manage your time wisely and find your own answers as you navigate school life.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_12: An ID issued by the school to every student. Use it to view your personal details and Friends List. This little card is essential for getting in and out of school and enjoying student-exclusive perks.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_13:
A special cookie handmade by Roccia, available only for a limited time during school events. Made in the shape of Principal Abby, it comes in a range of flavors.
Pero says you should try it if you get the chance!
SolarSchoolItemDescription_14:
A painting by the renowned artist "SubmittingTomorrow." Its loose brushwork exudes a serene, ethereal grace. Mist seems to drift from the scroll amid faint silhouettes of distant mountains, transporting the viewer beyond worldly cares.
Increases Aesthetics when obtained.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_15:
A simply designed necklace set with a clear, brilliant gemstone. Its color evokes a cloudless sky, leaving your mind feeling just as clear.
Increases Thinking when obtained.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_16:
After you got Buling to publish a "legendary post" on the forum, you became a school legend. Someone gave you this oddly familiar-looking item as a token of admiration.
For some reason, carrying it seems to increase your Popularity.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_17:
A notebook of unknown origin. It contains detailed notes on commonly misunderstood question types, with clear explanations and helpful illustrations that make it a valuable study aid.
Increases Knowledge when obtained.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_18:
A seal given to you by Abby. Technically, it's reserved for the Principal alone. Abby must trust you a great deal to give it to you.
Increases all stats when obtained.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_19: The grand prize from the Special Scratch-Off Event. The pen's obsidian barrel has a luxurious sheen, and the nib is gold-plated. Its weight feels reassuring in your hand. Write your homework with it, and the paper beneath your nib might as well be a contract worth tens of millions. Increases all stats when obtained.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_20:
A gift from Changli. 
Behind her composed smile, she keeps her true feelings hidden, content to wander alone at the edges of the crowd. Yet all she really longs for is the warmth of companionship, the simple joy of being among friends, and a heart that no longer has to face the world alone.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_21:
A gift from Cartethyia. 
If you can't do something, work hard until you can. If you want something, go out and claim it! Her earnestness has an endearingly awkward edge, but she never holds back. And when she finally reached the end of her determined sprint, it was your hand she grasped.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_23: The grand prize from the Lucky Draw Event. This record features classical music performed under the baton of a renowned conductor. The sweeping, melancholy melody is enough to bring even the hardest heart to tears. Increases all stats when obtained.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_24: A brooch styled after Ciaccona, awarded for reaching the max level in the Club Association. On Club Leader Ciaccona's go—three, two, one! A few wrong notes won't hurt. As long as we're all playing together, we'll make beautiful music!
SolarSchoolItemDescription_25: A brooch styled after Changli, awarded for reaching the max level in the Student Council. Answering student emails, organizing campus events, standing up for students' rights, and bringing people together... For many students, the Student Council is a place to turn when they need support.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_26:
[Spring Exclusive] Green tea made from tender spring buds and infused with the delicate fragrance of jasmine. Each sip leaves a sweet aftertaste, with floral notes that linger on the palate.
The tea leaves it uses is extremely rare. It will probably take 28 days to restock the item...
SolarSchoolItemDescription_27:
[Summer Exclusive] An extra-large ice cream featuring three classic flavors: vanilla, strawberry, and chocolate. One bite is all it takes to beat the summer heat and shake off your fatigue.
The cream it uses is extremely rare. It will probably take 28 days to restock the item...
SolarSchoolItemDescription_28:
[Autumn Exclusive] A hearty, crisp biscuit baked with freshly harvested wheat, nuts, and dried fruit. Its rich, toasty flavor makes you appreciate the bounty of the harvest.
The nuts and fruits needed to make the biscuit are extremely rare. It will probably take 28 days to restock the item...
SolarSchoolItemDescription_29:
[Winter Exclusive] A calorie-packed dessert in a compact, portable package, topped with candied fruit. A quick burst of energy to keep you going, even in the middle of winter.
The honey it uses is extremely rare. It will probably take 28 days to restock the item...
SolarSchoolItemDescription_30:
A bottle of sour soy milk with a rather peculiar smell.
Reduces Fatigue when consumed.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_31: Fresh bread, rich with the aroma of wheat.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_32: The very soul of a late-night snack.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_33:
For many students, this is the last resort before an all-nighter turns into an exam-day disaster.
Reduces Fatigue when consumed.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_34: Just water and jam, yet somehow an extraordinary treat.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_35: Who says you need a movie to enjoy popcorn?
SolarSchoolItemDescription_36: It's just a sour plum drink. Nothing more, nothing less.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_37:
Learning to love "Dr. Chili Pepper" is the first step to becoming a top-tier brainiac.
Reduces Fatigue when consumed.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_38:
It's just sugar and saline, but the placebo effect is powerful. Many students swear they feel more alert after drinking it.
Reduces Fatigue when consumed.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_40:
Some savor every sip. Others drink it to make their suffering last a little longer.
Reduces Fatigue when consumed.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_41: A mouthwatering wood-fired pizza piled high with sliced sausage. Its golden crust is lightly puffed around the edges, and every topping is smothered in melted cheese. One look is enough to work up an appetite.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_42: Every noodle is tossed in a rich, savory sauce, sending a mouthwatering aroma wafting through the air with the rising steam.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_43:
A friendly reminder: no drink can replace a good night's sleep.
Reduces Fatigue when consumed.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_46: The sauce art on top is what makes Omelette Rice truly special.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_47: The jolt of snapping open the bottle perks you up more than the tonic itself.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_48:
A special ticket issued by Eekky Logistics for school events. Take part in eligible events to redeem your rewards. As one of the school's biggest sponsors, Eekky Logistics has long supported the school's growth and activities.
Eek eek! Feeling lucky? Give it a try! Eek eek!
SolarSchoolItemDescription_49:
The school store's signature treat, baked by Roccia herself.
Infused with a rich coffee aroma as they bake, these biscuits are crisp and fragrant, with a deep, lingering finish. Pair them with your favorite drink during a break between classes or a lazy afternoon, and savor a little moment of indulgence.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_50: After what they've been through, these ingredients deserve a proper burial.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_51:
A special concoction served at the Student Council Cafe during the School Anniversary.
You choose the ingredients and decide how hard to stir, with a little "Student Council Magic" thrown in. All you need to crack it open is a straw and a whole lot of courage. The taste? Let's just say you'll never forget it!
SolarSchoolItemDescription_52:
An abstract painting of your own creation.
Geometric shapes and bold blocks of color fill the canvas. Some might call it worthless; others see a reflection of their own soul. Art has no right or wrong answers. Only you can decide what your work means.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_53:
A landscape painting of your own creation.
A quiet bay unfolds across the canvas, its gentle hues soothing the soul. You can almost hear the waves lapping against the shore.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_54:
A sketch drawn by your own hand.
Black, white, and gray strokes dance across the page, stripping away the distractions of color to reveal the subject in its simplest form. A perfect way to hone your artistic fundamentals.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_55:
A cassette packed with pop hits.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_56:
A writing instrument with a distinctly old-fashioned charm.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_57:
After the cookies are gone, the tin would make for a handy little storage box.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_58:
A handicraft enthusiast's most trusted partner.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_59:
Crunchy biscuit sticks dipped in chocolate, perfect for sharing with friends.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_60:
A once-popular handheld game that lets you raise your very own pixelated Namipon. All the joy of having a pet, without a single stray hair on your clothes.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_61:
A whole box of rich, creamy matcha ice pops with refreshing coolness.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_62:
Crispy, deep-fried flat bamboo flowers. Each bag comes with a handful of flowers and enough fragrant air to fill the rest.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_63:
A tiny world where life flourishes without bounds.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_64:
A home gaming console that was once all the rage. Years later, it's not the games you remember, but the afternoons spent laughing and playing with friends.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_65:
Thin slices of potato, fried to a perfect crunch. Somehow, they're even more tempting at half price.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_66:
A fragrant brew with a hint of bitterness up front and a lingering sweetness. A true tea connoisseur might even uncover layers of flavor hidden beneath the first sip.
Maybe someone out there would like this.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_67:
Proof of your intent to acquire the school and the funds to back it up.
With Phoebe's help, you negotiate with the School Board, complete asset reviews, and clear the legal hurdles before signing the acquisition agreement. You acquire the school for a sum close to Celestial Steed Corp's evaluation, promising to preserve its educational philosophy for years to come.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_68:
A graduation yearbook filled with the bright smiles of your classmates and snapshots of ordinary yet unforgettable days.
All the time spent together is preserved between its pages, turning every encounter and shared memory into a cherished keepsake.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_69:
A sheet of music left behind by a girl with aqua-blue hair. There's something about her that feels strangely familiar, as though you've known her for years. And yet... you've barely met, haven't you?
The melody looks playable on the piano. You're still struggling to read sheet music, but perhaps one day you'll be able to play it yourself...
SolarSchoolItemDescription_70: A proposal obtained after successfully securing sponsorship for the Liaison Center. Proof of an Emergency Event well done.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_71: A Bluetooth speaker awarded after the Student Council's successful presentation. Proof of an Emergency Event well done.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_72: A metronome awarded for successfully holding the joint performance for the Club Association. Proof of an Emergency Event well done.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_73:
Proof that your Reputation and Influence have reached their peak.
With Buling spearheading the publicity campaign, your rising fame has drawn the media's attention. The school's reputation is on the mend, and enrollment is looking up. As public confidence in the school's future grows, so do opportunities for corporate partnerships and sponsorships.
SolarSchoolItemDescription_74:
A gift from the Shorekeeper. This delicate flower-shaped brooch seems to be modeled after a particular plant.
Through years of lonely watch, she has treasured every moment you've shared, every meeting and reunion beneath the endless night sky. She'll remember them all, always, until the day she once again lights your way home along the shore.

SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1205_Intro: As the Student Council President, she leads new students on tours of the school. Somehow, every look she gives you seems loaded with meaning...
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1208_Intro: A humanities teacher who's got a stern look, yet is surprisingly popular among the students. Heads turn whenever she walks by.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1305_Intro: A mild-mannered, levelheaded Student Council Officer who maintains the Student Council's website portal. He's also said to have made quite a name for himself in academic research.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1307_Intro: A cheerful "walking encyclopedia" who runs the school forum. Rumor has it she has made plenty of friends online and has a vast intelligence network.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1407_Intro: A warm, friendly third-year who is the Leader of the Orchestral Music Club. She can play all sorts of instruments and has a real gift for music.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1409_Intro: A first-year about to start at the school, who seems to have a real passion for orchestral music.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1503_Intro: A gentle, kind science teacher and your homeroom teacher this year. She looks... much younger than she really is.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1505_Intro: A mysterious girl who draws your attention. You seem to have met her before, but when?
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1506_Intro: A girl whose every move exudes a noble air, always escorted by bodyguards. Rumor has it she is the heir of some gang.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1508_Intro: A diligent, meticulous second-year student who works as a Liaison Center Officer. She also helps out at her parents' family restaurant.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_1606_Intro: A clerk at the school store who is always happy to help. She is very skilled in crafts and remarkably mature for her age.
SolarSchoolRoleInfo_ABu_Intro: A mysterious creature calling itself "Uncle Abby," here to welcome you to town. Surely you two have met before... right?

SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_10: Good day... I mean, hello, {PlayerName}. I'm just out for a stroll. Oh, and don't mind my bodyguards...
Hello, {PlayerName}. I've heard that close friends text each other in their free time to stay in touch... Would it be a bother if I started messaging everyone?
{PlayerName}, I've prepared gifts for everyone! They're property deeds from Celestial Steed Corp, to thank you all for taking such good care of me... H-huh? Is that... not an appropriate gift?
May the gentle breeze bring a bountiful catch, and may the divinities bring every ship safely home. Mm, I learned that at my old school church. Somehow, it's stuck with me ever since...
Livia, Brenno, over here— Ah, {PlayerName}! P-please don't tell Father about this. He doesn't allow me to get too close to stray cats...
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_11: If you're interested, {PlayerName}, please come by my family's restaurant often. My parents have been experimenting with new dishes lately, and they both think very highly of you.

The blueprint for my "Fully Automatic Precision Cake Divider" could still use some work... It's meant to solve that pesky problem where every slice gets smaller the further you cut. Interested in hearing the details, {PlayerName}?

My parents say we must have you over for another meal before you graduate, {PlayerName}. I've recently designed a kitchen tool that cuts carrots and potatoes into equal portions at the same time. Please do come and try it, {PlayerName}.
Welcome. Today's special is miso ramen with octopus dumplings. I've saved a seat for you, {PlayerName}. I'll go tell Dad to start cooking.
Would you like some chocolate biscuit sticks? They're a quick way to replenish your energy, and they taste good, too. But of course, the more important thing is to balance work and rest.
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_1_: If you ever need a hand settling in, just come see us at the Student Council. Don't worry about being a bother. It's always a pleasure talking with you.
Like shopping? There are some lovely spots around town. Let's take a walk around together when you're free. I know one shop with a pair of earrings that would really bring out your eyes.
When did I get so used to you walking beside me? Hehe... Whatever the road ahead, having someone at my side like this... I suppose I don't mind it.
The square is so lively. Everyone's just going about their day. It always warms my heart to see. Hehe, as the saying goes, "A peaceful land makes for happy homes."
It's rare that you get a free moment to stop by. I've just finished with the students' letters, so if you're in no hurry, care for a game of Weiqi?
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_2_: I'm so excited to see what campus life has in store! What about you, {PlayerName}? Got any plans? Maybe we can make some together!
I heard that every summer break, everyone goes to the beach together! Swimming, beach volleyball, tests of courage, ghost stories at pajama parties.... I can't wait! I wanna do it all with everyone!
When I think about you graduating soon, {PlayerName}, I just... Sniff. No, no! Times like this are exactly when I have to keep my chin up! {PlayerName}, let's have another adventure today!
Never skip your warm-up! Before I run 20 laps around the field, I usually jog two easy laps to warm up first... Huh? {PlayerName}, why are you running away?

I think my trumpet playing's getting better! Want to hear, {PlayerName}? I don't have any accompaniment right now, but... Hmm, that's fine! Playing solo makes it easier to hear what I still need to work on!
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_4_: Ta-da—a cookie, perfectly paired with your coffee. Are you here to study, work, shop, or see me, {PlayerName}?
Ah, you found me! As a reward—ta-da! A Disguise Sleep Mask. With this, you can doze off in class without anyone noticing.
Ah, you found me! As a reward—ta-da! Vacation Sunglasses. With these, you can go to the beach no matter how bright the sun gets.
Ah, you found me! As a reward—ta-da! A Fate Eraser. If an exam question really has you stumped, toss it and let fate decide.
Um... I didn't bring any reward items today, and I have nothing to sell you, {PlayerName}. But I did bring my box. If you get tired, {PlayerName}, you can curl up inside for a little rest.
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_5_: An assassin lives by three rules: precision, composure, and patience. Wait for the opening, then strike once. Reading comprehension is no different.
Damn, it's hot... Time to cool off with a Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze.
When you're chasing a target, clearing obstacles is only half the job. The real trick is keeping your head clear. Think like a sniper: steady breath, steady aim, one perfect shot.
All clear. No threats in sight. Seems like today's pop quiz can proceed as planned.
Even when there's no danger around, you still need to exercise to keep your heart healthy and body fat in check. How about a lap around the field with me?
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_6_: All I want is to see every one of you grow up healthy and strong, like Starflowers pushing their way through the soil!
Schoolwork matters, but so does staying healthy! Drink plenty of water, eat your veggies, and... hmm, drink lots of milk to help you grow tall!
Every summer, seeds from faraway places drift into town on the breeze, take root, and bloom into lovely flowers. Hehe, a little like you, {PlayerName}!
"Why aren't you home studying at this hour?" Hehe, as if I'd ever say that! Whatever shape or color my nursery flowers grow into, every single one makes me proud!
Did you know, {PlayerName}, that the mushrooms in this hot pot dish aren't really plants? They're fungi! ...Oh dear, there I go turning everything into a lesson again...
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_7_: You dare talk to me like that? I'll have your—Ahaha, if it isn't {PlayerName}! What account? Boss, you must be seeing things, hahaha.
Eerie music, flipped mirrors, mannequins that move on their own... Ugh, clickbait, clickbait, clickbait! Where am I supposed to find anything actually worth posting?
Hey, I DO log off the forum sometimes!! Look, Ciaccona just posted a new song. Here, take these headphones. Wanna listen together?
Hey, everybody! Today I'm taking you all to... Oh, it's {PlayerName}? Wanna join my stream? We'll split the gifts fifty-fifty!
*Furious keyboard clacking* "You've got no proof, and you still have the nerve to say..." Hah! Blocked me already? That's it? Come back and argue when you've practiced for another two years!
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_8_: Everyone, follow my lead— Da, da-la da-da-la da-da, da-da-la da-da!
Hello there! Want to join the Orchestral Music Club? Oh, it's {PlayerName}... Hehe, sorry about that. It's a reflex. I shout that at pretty much everyone I see.
Today's theme is freedom and life! Hey, {PlayerName}, want to join my impromptu street concert? It'll be a lot of fun, I promise!

Every meeting ends in a farewell, and every farewell brings a new beginning... Sigh, just thinking about graduation is making my music all mushy. What if I start crying in the middle of a performance?
Being by the beach always makes me want to sing something romantic! C'mon, follow the rhythm of the waves with me— Lulala, lululala, lulala!
SolarSchool_CharacterUI_FixedLocation_9_: The Student Council gets such lovely natural light. Somehow, I think more clearly here. If something is troubling you, you're welcome to sit with me here for a while.

When I'm working on a research topic, I'd rather get out and stretch my legs now and then than spend hours cooped up in the lab. Even if I don't stumble on a new idea, a chat with you is interesting in its own right.

If you get stuck on a problem, you can have "Xiang-LEE" help you. In return, though, you'll have to keep it company and chat a little. After all, talking with someone as special as you is a learning experience for it, too.
For both me and "Xiang-LEE," the feelings we experience when talking with people are a precious frame of reference. I treasure moments when I get to feel something new.
Oh, you like this place too? What a coincidence. Heh heh. It's not exactly a balanced meal, but sometimes it's nice to forget all those rules and just enjoy something delicious.

SolarSchool_SpecialApprovalDescription_1: The School Anniversary is the school's chance to show everyone what it's really like. Organize the records of its history, explain its educational philosophy, put student work and everyday school life on display... It's fiddly work, but it gives guests a fuller picture of the school. Chances like this don't come often, so get ready properly with everyone at the Student Council!

While going through the Student Council's recent applications, Changli found one that has been stuck for some time. A first check shows nothing wrong with the application itself. Required materials were simply left out during a handover, so it never moved on to the next stage. She asks you to help find out where it currently stands, contact the person in charge to confirm the details, and supply the missing materials so the application can move forward.

The Student Council is planning a school event, but the students in charge of the discussion cannot agree on any of several alternative plans, each with its own pros and cons. Changli has reviewed the existing materials, yet she is in no hurry to decide. She wants to hear everyone's thoughts first. She has contacted the people involved and invites you to join her in hearing their views on the different plans and the reasoning behind them, as a reference for settling on the final one.

Act submissions for the School Anniversary's Arts Gala are officially open! Next comes collecting sign-ups, fitting each club's rehearsals into the schedule, confirming the lineup, and reviewing the acts... Every step needs careful handling. Help the Club Association get it all ready, so everyone gets a chance to show what they've got on stage.

Help the Orchestral Music Club go through all its instruments and accessories. Count them, note what shape each one's in, check the fragile parts one at a time, and finish with whatever cleaning and maintenance they need. This is the last round of preparations before the performance, so make sure every instrument is in good condition for the upcoming qualifiers!

Galbrena plans to weave a batch of dreamcatchers by hand as gifts for the students. She asks you to help prepare the materials, picking out suitable feathers, beads and colored thread, then weaving them carefully into one-of-a-kind dreamcatchers. Weave good wishes into every strand, so that these little charms keep everyone's nights peaceful and carry away worries, stress and bad dreams.

While grading reading assignments, Galbrena noticed that students had offered many different interpretations of the same literary work. She plans to use the chance to teach everyone to read a work from different angles. She asks you to help check the relevant passages, find the textual evidence behind each reading, and organize it all in preparation for the coming class discussion.

Coursework and daily routines have been keeping everyone busy lately, so Galbrena has decided to set her tasks aside for a while and treat herself to a cool dessert break. She would like you to join in, tend each plant carefully, and record how every one of them grows. Once there are enough observations, compile the new findings into the school's ecological plant guide together!

Lately, Verina has noticed that one student in her class often skips group activities after school and rarely joins in discussions with classmates. She is concerned about this student, but does not want to jump to conclusions without knowing the facts. She asks you to help find out how they have been doing recently and whether they are having trouble with their studies or daily life, and then to talk together about whether they need help.

She asks you to help organize the lab materials, check for the missing information, and ask the students involved to confirm their procedures so you can complete the records as fully as possible.

With rehearsal fast approaching, she hurried to find you and asks for your help tracking down the mysteriously vanished score...

Ciaccona has listened to the rehearsal recordings over and over and tried rearranging the parts, but still cannot find the root of the problem. She suspects the instruments themselves may be at fault. She invites you to listen to the recordings with her when you have free time and pick out the instrument whose tone sounds off in that passage.

With one job after another piling up, Abby asks you to make a trip to the restaurant and bring a portion of the new dish back. There is no time to lose. Get there before the new dish sells out, and try it on behalf of the busy principal.

Put the work aside for a bit and spend some relaxed, happy time with Abby, so the busy principal can enjoy a moment of leisure too.
